name: diagram-frame
title: DiagramFrame
description: A board with a panel: flat parts on AdaptivePane, so the panel is a column beside the board when there's the room, a drawer over it that doesn't dim it at medium sizes, and a page pushed over it on a phone. A bar on the board opens it (and a Diagram's fit leaves room for it), a cover with a back bar goes over everything, and titled sections fill the panel, with the kit's Field and Input (onValueCommit) for its fields.
